items.title: 10.21 Feasibility of redox reactions from the activity series or reaction data (activity series ya reaction data se redox reaction ka hona ya na hona) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 10.21 with Quick Check 10.9, printed page 238.

blocks.text: Activity series asal mein metals ki reactivity series hai, zyada reactive se kam reactive tak. Is se single displacement reactions ke products maloom kiye jate hain: metal M₁ solution mein doosre metal M₂ ki jagah le leta hai (use bahar nikal deta hai) agar M₁ series mein M₂ se oopar ho.

Activity series se maloom kar sakte hain ke reaction mumkin hai ya nahi. Half reactions ke potentials se cell ka potential nikalte hain: agar positive ho to reaction mumkin hai, negative ho to mumkin nahi. Misalein dekhein:
Cell potential positive hai, is liye reaction mumkin (feasible) hai.
Ek aur misal. Activity series se:

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne silver ka E° ‘+0.080 V’ chhapa hai; sahi +0.80 V hai (isi se Fe + 2Ag⁺ ka +1.24 V banta hai). Doosri misal mein kitab ki equation Al³⁺ + Ag → Al + Ag⁺ balanced nahi; sahi Al³⁺ + 3Ag → Al + 3Ag⁺ hai. Kitab ne −1.66 + 0.080 = −0.86 V likha hai; sahi E°cell = −1.66 − 0.80 = −2.46 V hai. Jawab phir bhi negative hai, is liye reaction mumkin nahi.
Dono half-cell reactions se nikla E°cell negative hai, is liye yeh reaction mumkin nahi.

blocks.caption: Series se feasibility
rows: haan: Fe, Ag se oopar hai
nahi: Ag, Al se neeche hai

blocks.prompt: a) Nernst equation state (bayan) karein; electrochemistry mein is ki kya importance (ahmiyat) hai?
blocks.explanation: E = E° + (RT/zF) ln([oxidized]/[reduced]), ya 298 K par E = E° + (0.059/z) log([oxidized]/[reduced]). Is se maloom hota hai ke non-standard concentration aur temperature par electrode ya cell ka potential kitna hoga.

blocks.prompt: b) Ion concentration badalne ka half reaction ke electrode potential par kya asar hai?
blocks.explanation: Oxidized form (left side) ki concentration barhane se E zyada positive hota hai; ghatane se zyada negative. Misal: [Zn²⁺] 1.00 se zyada → −0.61 V, kam → −0.80 V (topic 10.18).

blocks.prompt: c) E° Ag⁺/Ag = +0.80 V, Cr²⁺/Cr = −0.91 V, Fe²⁺/Fe = −0.44 V. i) Sab se strong (taqatwar) aur sab se kamzor oxidizing agent? ii) Ag, Cr, Fe ko reducing power ki barhti tarteeb mein likhein.
blocks.explanation: i) Ag⁺ (sab se positive E°) sab se strong, Cr²⁺ (sab se negative) sab se kamzor oxidizing agent. ii) Ag < Fe < Cr.

blocks.prompt: d) 0.01 M Cu²⁺ mein dube Cu electrode ka potential kya hai? (E° Cu²⁺/Cu = +0.34 V)

items: Oopar wala metal neeche wale ko solution se displace karta hai (nikal deta hai).
E°cell = E°(reduce hone wala) − E°(oxidize hone wala): positive → mumkin.
